en.headline: Mother of late singer Anita Mui dies aged 102 in Causeway Bay
en.dek: Tam Mei-kam collapsed while being fed liquid oatmeal at her Leighton Road flat on Sunday morning and was later certified dead at Ruttonjee Hospital.
body: The 102-year-old mother of the late Cantopop singer Anita Mui Yim-fong died on Sunday morning after collapsing at her home in Causeway Bay, according to police and hospital sources.

A domestic helper reported that Tam Mei-kam lost consciousness at about 10.30am while being fed liquid oatmeal at a flat in Leigyinn Building on Leighton Road. Paramedics found her unconscious and took her to Ruttonjee Hospital in Wan Chai, where she was certified dead at 11.27am.

Police said there were no suspicious injuries on the body and no suspicious objects at the scene. Sources indicated Tam had a history of heart disease and hypertension and required a liquid diet and regular medication.

zh.headline: 梅艷芳母親覃美金銅鑼灣寓所離世 享年102歲
zh.dek: 周日早上在禮頓道單位進食流質食物時暈倒，送往律敦治醫院後證實不治，警方指現場無可疑。
body: 已故歌手梅艷芳的母親覃美金（梅媽）周日早上在銅鑼灣禮頓道寓所離世，享年102歲。
警方接獲外傭報案，指覃美金約上午10時半在禮頓道利景樓單位進食流質麥皮時突然暈倒。救護員到場發現事主昏迷，送往灣仔律敦治醫院搶救，上午11時27分證實不治。
警方表示，事主身上無可疑傷痕，寓所內亦無可疑物品。消息指覃美金有心臟病及高血壓病歷，日常需進食流質食物及定時服藥。
